title: 10% off "Almost Everything" in Store & Online @ IKEA
body:
Deal: 10% off "Almost Everything" in Store & Online @ IKEA

[Disabled-User] Whenever I go to IKEA, I can’t leave without buying ridiculous amounts of things for my house. I’m suffering from Stock-Home Syndrome. Goodnight everybody!
[Wiadro] IKEA has discontinued a bunch of products and complete product lines.
Still hasn’t announced what they are replacing them with.
[Disabled-User] Not sure, but their breakfast menu is also changing soon. I hope I still can get an umlaut from their cafe.
[prelude] Lately they do seem to have be taking the 'fast fashion' approach to homewares with how fast they're turning out products then getting rid of them which is a little disappointing
[EspadaV8] We found this out the other day. The bar stools we bought last year are no longer available, but they still use the images for the section. Very annoying.
[onyx981] The extra 10% is to offset the pain of being Canadian.
You can just use discounted giftcards to reach 20%.
[Mr Frodo] Where can you get discounted gift cards and is there a limit? What is the maximum amount on a gift card? Thinking of doing renos, so this would be handy. Thanks in advance
[surfingedge] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/981600
No known limit to the number of GCs that can be used
[lzaonne] @surfingedge: I used 7 last time no issues
[Averell] I used 10 in one transaction. Didn't see the limit mentioned anywhere.
10% is usually from Colesworths, if you can wait.
4-7% is more often, from many gift cards stores.
Max amount per giftcard is $500.
[King Steuart] The couch I want is 'not stocked at' stores in Vic, but available for delivery. How do I order it using lots of gift cards? Can I still go in-store and order it on their self serve?
[Chicago1] Views or knowledge of it will work with the 35 off 150 vouchers I felt compelled to go spend to earn?
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/979692
[jingsu6688] kmart is the new ikea since covit and the ikea founder died
[thewooz] With all the significant price inflation at Ikea in recent times 10% off doesnt compensate for much at all
